newsitem.title: UK: Electra forms JV with Broadview.
newsitem.headline: Electra forms JV with Broadview.

text.p: Electra Investment Trust Plc said on Monday it was forming a new joint venture company with Broadview Associates to raise and manage venture capital funds dedicated to investing in European IT companies.
The new company will be called Kennet Capital and will raise an initial fund of up to 35 million stg. Electra Fleming will commit 10 million stg to the fund.

Electra Fleming is an investment management company specialising in private equity financing and will commit the 10 million stg on behalf of its clients. Electra Fleming is jointly owned by Electra Investment Trust and Robert Fleming Bank.
Electra Fleming's chairman, Fred Vinton, said, "With the contributions of both partners, the joint venture will be uniquely placed to make good investments."
Broadview is a specialist mergers and acquisition adviser to the information technology (IT) industry.
